data.text: [00:03.9]Good morning, James. `[00:06.5]Come in. `[00:07.5]Now, you wanted to talk to me about taking the day off on Friday?

[00:11.8]Yes, that’s right. `[00:13.2]The thing is … if possible, I’d like to have the day off because my brother is over here from Australia for two weeks … and he’s got tickets for a show. `[00:24]It’s really special and I’d really like to go.

[00:27]I understand what you’re saying, yes. `[00:30]I know that you don’t see your brother much and this sounds like a chance you don’t want to miss. `[00:35.5]Ermm … what about the report? `[00:39]Will you able to finish it by the end of Thursday?
[00:41.8]Yes, no problem. `[00:43.5]Obviously, I’ll make sure that the report is finished before I go and I’ll work late this week if necessary.
[00:51.6]Yes, I know that you work long hours and I’m very pleased with your work. `[00:57]Ermm … I think it sounds fine. `[01:00.5]Go ahead and have a good day.
[01:02.9]Thank you very much for your understanding.
[01:05.8]Not at all. `[01:07]And I hope you have a good time.
